VbHwU.content: Platform-wide configuration for this Gameplane instance.

children.content: Built-in local accounts plus federated identity providers. Changes take effect on save — no restart needed.
At least one identity provider must stay enabled — the last enabled provider can't be turned off.

children.name: cardSubtitle
children.content: Read-only snapshot of the identity provider configured via api.oidc.* Helm values at install time. Connection settings are not editable here; role mappings can be overridden below.

children.name: oidcHeaderHint
children.content: Groups claim and default role are seeded from the same Helm values and are not editable here.

children.name: Description
children.content: Every OIDC user currently signs in with the viewer default role. Two ways to change that: add mappings in Role mapping overrides below — they apply from the next login, with no restart or Helm re-run — or seed them at install time with api.oidc.roleMappings.admin / .operator / .viewer in your Helm values.

children.name: cardSubtitle
children.content: Map IdP groups to Gameplane roles from here. Nothing is seeded from Helm on this install, so every mapping you add is stored in the dashboard. A change takes effect the next time an affected user logs in — no restart or reinstall needed.

children.name: emptyText_admin
children.content: No groups mapped — nobody signs in as admin via OIDC.

children.name: emptyText_operator
children.content: No groups mapped — nobody signs in as operator via OIDC.

children.name: emptyText_viewer
children.content: No groups mapped — nobody signs in as viewer via OIDC.

children.name: saveHelper
children.content: Saved changes take effect on next login for affected users — no restart or reinstall needed.
